title: A second cup. A familiar rival.
deck: Albion beat Aston Villa 3–0 in the FA Cup final.
body: Albion’s second FA Cup arrived in 1892 with a 3–0 win over Aston Villa. The two clubs were already regular opponents on football’s biggest stage: Villa had beaten Albion in the 1887 final and would do so again in 1895.
The photograph of the 1892 winners gives another view of the club’s Victorian cup sides. These were Stoney Lane years, before a move to The Hawthorns changed the setting of Albion’s story.
